label: sec:atomic-braid-mass-crossing-locality-cpt-preamble
html: The preceding sub-section developed foundations for the atomic-braid LP and mass formula. This sub-section establishes consequences for crossing grading, locality, and CPT orbits. We treat mass-volume factorization, the crossing-graded mass expansion, and lifted-crossing locality. We derive q-holonomy locality, Frobenius-packing density, and CPT-orbit closure density. Finally, we establish bar-involution invariance and soft-confinement at q_0.
